Setup.Name: Convert radian in degree
Setup.Description: Converts a radian angle in degrees using the expression syntax.
Setup.Manifest:
Version: 1.0

MqttConnections:
  - Name: "My broker"

OtelConnections:
  - Name: "My Otel server"
    ServiceName: "my-service"
    ServiceNamespace: "my-service-namespace"

Processors:
  - Name: "Sensor angle"
    Description: "Provides the current angle of the sensor."
    Mqtt: 
      Subscriptions:
        - Name: "Angle information in radian"
          Topic: "sensor/angle"
    Otel:
      Metrics:
        - Name: "Sensor.AngleInDegrees"          
          SignalDataType: Float
          Instrument: Gauge
          Value: "PAYLOAD() * 180 / [PI]"
